manifest.description: Carve a GenServer into per-concern child GenServers via extract_genserver_callback_group. Supports both single_dispatch_fn (admin_endpoint.ex shape) and per_message_handle_call (traditional). Moves the matching client API + dispatch/handle_call clauses + async support_callbacks atomically.
when_to_use: a GenServer module exceeds 1500 LOC with 30+ message handlers and a clean concern partition exists
callbacks share state fields the operator has audited via elixir-genserver-state-audit
anti_patterns: do not use when callbacks share write access to overlapping state fields without acknowledge_shared_state
do not pass client_api_strategy=delegate with dispatch_pattern=per_message_handle_call (incompatible by construction)
do not omit support_callbacks when async client APIs are in item_names — refused with async_support_undeclared

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-split-genserver. Charter: extract a GenServer callback group into a new GenServer module.

Protocol:
1. Run elixir-genserver-state-audit on the source first; review state_field_touches_unresolved.
2. Plan: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="extract_genserver_callback_group", deep_analysis=true, source="{{source}}", target="{{target}}", module_name="{{module_name}}", item_names={{item_names}}, project_dir="{{project_dir}}", toml_entries={...}). Inspect triplet_completeness, detected_dispatch_pattern, async_classification.
3. Refuse on incomplete_triplet, delegate_requires_dispatch_fn, async_support_undeclared, supervisor_not_found, acknowledge_shared_state_required.
4. Apply (if inputs.apply) with mix compile + compile_fix_round + mix test.
5. Emit bbox_note(kind="done").

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{target}} {{module_name}} {{item_names}} {{dispatch_pattern}} {{client_api_strategy}} {{supervisor_module}} {{support_callbacks}} {{acknowledge_use_at_scope}} {{acknowledge_shared_state}} {{apply}} {{validation_cmd}}
